title: Men accused of orchestrating Iran-linked antisemitic attacks in Sydney and Melbourne named and sanctioned
paragraphs: An Australian citizen in Iran and a former resident living in Iraq who the federal government allege orchestrated antisemitic attacks in Sydney and Melbourne on behalf of Iran have been named and sanctioned.

The foreign affairs minister, Penny Wong, alleged on Friday that Zohair Hassib and Kazem Hamad were behind the “horrific antisemitic arson attacks targeting Australia’s Jewish community” on behalf of Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC).
Wong in a statement claimed the men “used a complex chain of proxies” in 2024 to target Lewis’ Continental Kitchen in Sydney and the Adass Israel synagogue in Melbourne.
